desc: Derive and justify the pairwise visibility condition and threshold formula, including equality and height-zero edge cases.
Design a correct dynamic convex-hull method for maximizing thresholds in \(O(N\log N)\).
Prove the hull orientation and query monotonicity/tangent rule, including collinear points.
Implement the algorithm with exact integer comparisons and correct \(-1\) handling.
Validate the implementation against all four public samples and relevant edge cases.
